answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the anchor graph and each risks its bond. Because the saffron release is entered with every signature, the mirror audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
